title: Efficient Multimodal Agents for Auditing 3D Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2611.25543v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal agents can now build interactive 3D worlds and games, yet these worlds, like those built by people, often contain glitches such as floating objects, walls that can be walked through, or objects that change when no one is looking. An automatic auditor could check such worlds at scale and provide rewards for agents that build them, but only if it is both accurate and cheap. Auditing requires three abilities, namely navigating to the objects that may contain a glitch, triggering glitches that appear only after a specific behavior, and recognizing what is wrong. Current auditors are either accurate but slow and expensive or cheap but unreliable. We study how much of the audit small models can take on. A 4B vision language model fine-tuned end to end on verified trajectories of a frontier teacher guided by Bayesian search learns to navigate and trigger, and six such explorers together match a frontier model on both, but recognition

translated_title: 用于审计3D世界的高效多模态智能体
translated_abstract: 多模态智能体现在能够构建交互式3D世界和游戏，然而这些世界与人类构建的世界一样，常常包含诸如悬浮物体、可穿墙、或无人注视时发生变化的物体等故障。自动审计器可以大规模检查这些世界，并为构建这些世界的智能体提供奖励，但前提是它必须既准确又廉价。审计需要三种能力，即导航到可能包含故障的物体、触发仅在特定行为之后才会出现的故障、以及识别问题所在。当前的审计器要么准确但缓慢且昂贵，要么廉价但不可靠。我们研究了小型模型能够承担多少审计工作。一个4B参数的视觉语言模型在由贝叶斯搜索引导的前沿教师模型生成的经过验证的轨迹上进行端到端微调后，学会了导航和触发操作，六个这样的探索者联合起来在这两方面均能匹敌前沿模型，但在识别方面……
tldr: 该论文通过端到端微调4B小型视觉语言模型并让多个小型探索者协同工作，在导航和触发3D世界故障任务上达到前沿大模型水平，从而实现准确且廉价的自动化世界审计。
en_tdlr: Six fine-tuned 4B vision-language model explorers, trained end-to-end on verified trajectories from a Bayesian-search-guided frontier teacher, match a frontier model at navigating and triggering glitches, enabling accurate yet cheap automated auditing of 3D worlds.
